qa_pairs.question: When can a customer cancel an order and what happens if it is already packing?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is Confirmed. Once the status becomes Packing, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery.

contexts.text: An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`. Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. qa_pairs.question: What is the return window for devices ordered on or after September 1, 2026, and are there any fees?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery. An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. However, a defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

contexts.text: For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery. An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

qa_pairs.question: How long does a covered repair normally take and what are the service timeframes?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

contexts.text: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

qa_pairs.question: What should a customer do if they suspect their OrbitTech account has been compromised?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If an unauthorized order is still Confirmed, the customer should also attempt cancellation. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should also attempt cancellation under `02_orders_and_payments.md`. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

qa_pairs.expected_answer: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund. This rule also applies when the main device is otherwise within the return window.

qa_pairs.question: When does OrbitPlus extend the return window, and are there any limitations on this extension?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active. The extension only applies when the order was placed on or after September 1, 2026.

contexts.text: OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active. It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.

qa_pairs.question: How does OrbitTech handle a device that shows shipping damage versus a concealed defect discovered later?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Visible shipping damage or missing items must be reported within 48 hours after confirmed delivery with photographs of the label, box, and contents. A concealed defect discovered later follows the warranty or return policy rather than the shipping-damage process.

contexts.text: Visible shipping damage or missing items must be reported within 48 hours after confirmed delivery. The customer should keep the packaging and provide photographs of the label, box, and contents. A concealed defect discovered later follows the warranty or return policy rather than the shipping-damage process.

qa_pairs.question: How is the applicable policy version determined when the triggering event date is unclear?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: When support cannot determine the applicable version from available evidence, it should identify both possibilities and request the order date rather than guessing. The triggering event for return-policy eligibility is the order-placement date, while for warranty it is the delivery or store collection date, and for repair fees it is the repair authorization creation date.

contexts.text: When support cannot determine the applicable version from available evidence, it should identify both possibilities and request the order date rather than guessing.

For return-policy eligibility, the triggering event is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery. For warranty, the coverage period begins on delivery or store collection. For repair fees, the applicable policy is the version accepted when the repair authorization is created.

However, if you are an OrbitPlus member and the order was placed while membership was active, the unopened-device window extends to 45 calendar days, but this still does not cover 60 days. You may wish to check if the device has a covered defect under warranty.
